question: As of October 2020, who is the Chairman of the Department of Atomic Energy in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sh. K.N. Vyas**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sh. K.N. Vyas** is the Chairman of the Department of Atomic Energy in India as of October 2020.
 
• The Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) is directly under the Prime Minister of India and is responsible for nuclear technology, including nuclear power production and research.
 
• Sh. K.N. Vyas has been instrumental in advancing India's nuclear capabilities and promoting the peaceful use of nuclear energy.
 
• The DAE oversees various research institutions and nuclear power plants across the country, contributing significantly to India's energy security and scientific advancements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Department of Atomic Energy was established on **August 3, 1954**, and is headquartered in Mumbai.
 
• The DAE operates under the framework of India's **Atomic Energy Act, 1962**, which governs the development and regulation of atomic energy in the country.
 
• The DAE is involved in various areas such as nuclear power generation, nuclear fuel cycle, waste management, and radiation technology applications in medicine, agriculture, and industry.
 
• India's significant achievements in the field of nuclear science and technology are largely attributed to the efforts and leadership within the DAE.
 
• The DAE also plays a crucial role in international nuclear cooperation and safeguards, ensuring the peaceful use of nuclear energy.
